info.description: OpenAPI projection of the finance pillar's REST contract. Authored as a ts-rest contract (src/contract/rest.ts); consumed directly by polyglot clients and via openapi-typescript by TS consumers.
info.title: @pops/finance

get.summary: List accounts with optional search / kind / archived filters and pagination

post.summary: Create a new account; rejects a reserved kind with 422
Batch-update display order for a set of accounts atomically; an unknown id 404s the whole batch

delete.summary: Archive an account (sets archivedAt); idempotent if already archived

get.summary: Get a single account

patch.summary: Update an account, including unarchiving it by clearing archivedAt; rejects patching kind into a reserved value with 422

get.summary: An account’s balance as of a date (default today), and what it was anchored on
Month-end balances for the last `months` months (default 12), oldest first
List an account’s checkpoints, newest first, each with what the ledger predicted for it

post.summary: Record a balance read off the bank or counted by hand; always source manual. 422s a future date or an archived account

delete.summary: Delete a manual checkpoint; 409s an import or statement one, which is corrected by recording a newer checkpoint rather than removing what a file said

get.summary: Masked read of a gift card account’s details — never the number/PIN

put.summary: Create or replace a gift card account’s encrypted number/PIN

post.summary: Decrypt and return the plaintext number/PIN once; audited

get.summary: How an account expects to be fed; 404 for an account with no config

put.summary: Create or replace an account’s import config; 422s a config missing what its kind needs (a dialect, a parser or a provider)

get.summary: List the import batches that fed an account, newest first, paginated on createdAt
List a loan account’s offset links, closed ones included unless active=true

post.summary: Link an offset account to a loan account; any existing account may be the offset
Close an offset link (sets unlinkedAt) without deleting it; idempotent

get.summary: List every rate a loan account has carried, newest effective date first

post.summary: Record a rate change and mirror it onto the loan’s terms; 422s a non-latest effectiveFrom

get.summary: Read a loan account’s terms

put.summary: Create or replace a loan account’s terms, recording the matching rate history row atomically

post.summary: Merge account :id (the source) into targetId: repoint its transactions onto targetId and delete it outright. Irreversible — the caller should show the preview first
Preview merging account :id (the source) into targetId, without writing anything; rejects with 422 for a merge that cannot be meaningful (self, cross-currency, cross-sign-convention)
Start an Up sync for an account fed by the Up API, or report the one already running; 422 for an account not fed that way

get.summary: Progress and result of one sync job; 404 once it has expired
List budgets with optional search / period / active filters and pagination

post.summary: Create a budget

get.summary: Get a single budget (with spend aggregates)
List corrections with optional minConfidence / matchType filters and pagination

post.summary: Create a correction, or reinforce an existing one keyed on (pattern, matchType)
AI-derive a reusable rule (matchType/pattern/confidence) from one labelled transaction
Apply a correction-rule ChangeSet atomically; returns the full rule set
Find the winning correction for a description (null when none match)
AI-propose reusable tagging rules from a batch of transactions
List corrections with pending (un-persisted) ChangeSets folded in (temp: rows included), paginated
Preview the before/after match impact of a ChangeSet against caller-supplied transactions
Preview the transactions a candidate (pattern, matchType) rule would match
Propose an add/edit ChangeSet for a correction signal (adapts to prior rejections)
Record rejection feedback for a ChangeSet (best-effort; feeds the next proposal)
AI-revise an in-progress ChangeSet from a free-text instruction
List every DB transaction a candidate (pattern, matchType) rule matches, paged, with the full-DB match total

get.summary: Get a single correction by id

post.summary: Nudge a correction confidence by delta (deletes the row when it drops below 0.3)
Retroactively apply a correction rule to every existing transaction it currently wins against (#3660); dryRun previews without writing

get.summary: List every currency, fiat and points alike

post.summary: Register a new currency (or points program)

delete.summary: Delete a currency, refused while any table still references it

patch.summary: Edit a currency; changing decimals is refused with 409 while any account references it

get.summary: Data-quality nudges for the dashboard panel — checkpoint inconsistencies (largest |delta| first), then accounts stale past their own import cadence (most overdue first)
List entities with per-entity transactionCount; orphanedOnly=true returns count===0
Every pending import, most recently saved first, with the state a card shows (open, left-open and unusable are derived on read)

post.summary: Create a file draft; the creating tab holds the lease

delete.summary: Discard a draft. A live draft loses only its decisions; the bank resends the rows

get.summary: One draft with its payload; 409 DraftUnusable when this build cannot resume it

put.summary: Write the wizard state through; 409 DraftOwnedElsewhere from a tab that is not the owner

post.summary: Take the lease; 409 DraftOwnedElsewhere while another tab was seen inside the stale window unless forced
Prove the tab is still in it; 409 DraftOwnedElsewhere once the lease has moved
Give the lease up; a token that no longer holds it changes nothing
Apply a correction ChangeSet atomically, then re-evaluate the import session
Atomically create entities, apply changeSets + tag-rule changeSets, write transactions
Create a new entity during an import session
Start an import process (dedup + entity matching); returns a session id to poll

get.summary: Poll an import session for progress (null when the session is unknown/expired)

post.summary: Re-evaluate the import session against merged (DB + pending) rules; no DB writes
Search the finance pillar's domains (transactions, budgets, wishlist) for the unified search engine

get.summary: List effective values for every declared key (sensitive redacted)

post.summary: Batch-read settings by key (missing omitted; sensitive redacted)
Reset declared keys to defaults (omit keys ⇒ reset all)
Transactional batch write (all-or-nothing); returns the written mirror

get.summary: Read a single setting (null on unset; sensitive redacted)

post.summary: Internal-only write-once seed (encryption seed / client id)
Reset a single setting to its manifest default

get.summary: List tag rules with optional matchType/isActive/minConfidence filters and pagination; each row carries its ledgerMatchStatus (POPS-2941)

post.summary: Apply a tag-rule ChangeSet; upserts accepted new vocabulary tags

get.summary: The tag namespaces and who may mint a value on each

post.summary: List every DB transaction a candidate (pattern, matchType) tag rule matches, paged, with the full-DB match total
Preview the suggestion-impact of a tag-rule ChangeSet over the supplied transactions
Propose a tag-rule ChangeSet from a tag-edit signal (deterministic, with impact preview)
Reject a ChangeSet, recording the feedback against the refused ChangeSet
For each add op in each ChangeSet, whether it would create a rule or merge into one that already exists, and that rule's current tags (POPS-2955)

get.description: Ordered by how often each tag has been written onto a transaction, descending, with the tag itself breaking ties. The order is part of the response, not an accident of storage: the pickers preserve it, so the most-used value of each facet is the one a user reaches first. A client that sorts this list alphabetically is discarding the ranking.
get.summary: List the user tag vocabulary, most-used first (POPS-2616)
Get a single tag rule by id, with its ledgerMatchStatus (POPS-2941)

patch.summary: Edit a tag rule (entityId / tags / confidence / priority / isActive)

post.summary: Retroactively apply a tag rule to every existing matching transaction (#3660); dryRun previews without writing
Disable a tag rule (soft-delete: isActive=false)

parameters.description: Keyset anchor: the `date` of the last row you already have, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be sent together with `beforeId` — supplying one without the other is a 400, because a date alone cannot separate rows that share it. Returns rows sorting strictly after that row under `date DESC, id DESC`. Prefer this over `offset` when paging a list that can change underneath you.
parameters.name: beforeDate

parameters.description: Keyset anchor: the `id` of the last row you already have. Must be sent together with `beforeDate` — supplying one without the other is a 400. This half is what separates rows sharing a date.
parameters.name: beforeId
